items.title: How to Sync Obsidian for Free — No 24/7 Server, No Sync Conflicts | PC & iOS
items.description: Obsidian Starter Vault Download Free Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/33678f10a7 (Free) Pro Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/c8e544e005 (Donation) The Ultimate Vault: 🔗 https://ko-fi.com/s/cf438d571d My Ko-Fi Shop 🔗 https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/shop Become a Vault Explorer 🔗 https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/tiers 🔗 https://paulsvaultmembers.com/#join Join Paul's Vault Builders 🔗 https://www.skool.com/pauls-vault-builders-6631/about Syncthing Audit Ignore Patterns Command (Free for Vault Explorers) 🔗 https://ko-fi.com/s/faad513dea CHAPTERS 00:00 Intro 00:38 - What is Syncthing? 01:29 - How I'm syncing my devices for free (SyncTrayzor) 02:33 - Biggest Syncthing Complaint Sync-Conflicts 02:46 - Sync Conflicts Explained 03:21 - Sync Conflicts THE PROBLEM 03:51 - Sync Conflicts THE FIX 04:37 - Sync Audit .stignore-shared Creation 06:08 - Setting up SyncTrayzor v2 on Windows 11 10:03 - Setting up Synctrain on iPad iOS 15:50 - Setting up Synctrain on iPhone iOS 20:12 - Syncing your devices Remotely with Tailscale and 24/7 Server 20:34 - Outro VIDEO DESCRIPTION In today's video, I'm showing you how to sync your Obsidian vault between two devices. No server running 24/7. No third-party cloud service. Completely free. We'll cover Windows to iOS. But the same idea works for Mac or Linux too. If you're running multiple vaults, I'll also show you a better way to handle sync-conflicts — plus a tool that makes managing Syncthing on Windows way easier. In this video I walk through: - How to install Syncthing on your PC with SyncTrayzor - How to sync your Obsidian Vault with Synctrain - Local Network Setup Resources: Synctrain (Free iOS) 🔗 https://apps.apple.com/au/app/synctrain/id6553985316 SyncTrayzor v2 (Free PC) 🔗 https://github.com/GermanCoding/SyncTrayzor/releases/latest Syncthing Project 🔗 https://syncthing.net/ Want this to reach your devices when your PC's off or you're away from home? That needs an always-on server + Tailscale — full walkthrough here: The Ultimate Self-Hosted Obsidian Sync Setup (PC & iOS) 📽️ https://youtu.be/J-YO7rn8ZEQ?si=ohNqeszVeHGpOBC7 ☕ Buy me a Coffee https://ko-fi.com/motion2082 Syncthing Audit Ignore Patterns Command (Free for Vault Explorers) 🔗 https://ko-fi.com/s/faad513dea How to create the .stignore-shared file for any vault? 1) Add this line to every device's Syncthing "Ignore Patterns" box: "#include .stignore-shared" 2) Sync a .stignore-shared file to each device: // Obsidian's own per-device UI state — regenerated constantly, never worth syncing .obsidian/workspace.json .obsidian/workspace-mobile.json .obsidian/graph.json .obsidian/vault-stats.json // logs and backups anywhere under .obsidian .obsidian/**/*.log .obsidian/**/*.bak // let Syncthing clear conflict copies inside config only — keep note conflicts visible (?d).obsidian/**/*.sync-conflict-* 🤖 Optional Prompt for creating .stignore-shared with your AI Tools "I use Syncthing to sync my Obsidian vault across devices and I'm getting .sync-conflict files inside .obsidian. Help me build a .stignore-shared file. Ask me which plugins I have, then for each one tell me whether its data file is real settings I'd have to rebuild (keep syncing) or regenerable cache/UI state (ignore). Rules: comment lines start with // not #; never ignore app.json, appearance.json, hotkeys.json, core-plugins.json, community-plugins.json, or snippets/ or themes/; only put (?d) on .sync-conflict-* lines; never ignore note conflict files outside .obsidian." #Obsidian #Syncthing #ObsidianSync #SelfHosted #PKM

items.title: Your Obsidian Web Clipper Isn't Broken. Claude.ai Just Can't Be Clipped
items.description: Your Obsidian Web Clipper isn't broken — a Claude chat physically can't be clipped. Claude only keeps the messages near your screen loaded and drops the rest as you scroll, so there's no moment where the whole conversation exists on the page to grab. You get half a note, every time. items.title: Obsidian Properties | Skip This and You'll Regret It (Bases, Web Clipper & AI)
items.description: 📦 OBSIDIAN VAULTS 🔗 Free Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/33678f10a7 (Free) 🔗 Pro Kit: https://ko-fi.com/s/c8e544e005 (Donation) 🔗 Ultimate Vault: https://ko-fi.com/s/cf438d571d 🔗 Ko-Fi Shop: https://ko-fi.com/motion2082/shop 🤖 OBSIDIAN AI TOOLS ($7/month) 🔗 https://obsidianaitools.com/ VIDEO DESCRIPTION Two years ago I made a video about YAML properties, and it's still one of the most watched videos on this channel. But Obsidian Bases changed everything — properties are now what power every base in your vault, and they're more important than ever. In this video I show you the bases running my real vault (my Ideas base, my YouTube library and a timeline of every note I create), how the Obsidian Web Clipper fills in properties for you, and the mistake I made four years ago that left hundreds of notes with no metadata — plus how I fix those old notes with AI in minutes instead of weeks. If you're new to Obsidian, stick around for the beginner tutorial at the end: building an ideas template with YAML properties and wiring it to QuickAdd, so every new note starts with the right metadata. ⏱️ CHAPTERS 00:00 — Intro - Why Properties matter 00:22 — The Ideas Base: Why Properties Matter 02:24 — The YouTube Vault Base 04:51 — Obsidian Web Clipper: Properties Filled For You 06:36 — Video Notes with Media Extended 07:08 — Note Retrieval Timeline: Everything In One Place 08:00 — The Mistake I Made Four Years Ago 09:10 — Fixing Old Notes with AI 10:48 — Building an Ideas Template (Beginner Tutorial) 12:30 — Every Property Type Explained 15:29 — QuickAdd Template Choice Setup 18:05 — Outro 🎬 RELATED VIDEOS 🔗 The original YAML Properties video (2024): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=diZ4AFh-ZNI 🔗 Hiding Annoying YAML Properties: https://youtu.be/cigqRZUY7YA 🔗 Obsidian Web Clipper + AI: https://youtu.be/DS75Vw4IyoA 🔌 PLUGINS SHOWN Obsidian Web Clipper (browser extension): https://obsidian.md/clipper QuickAdd, Commander, Media Extended, Folder Notes — all in the community plugin store 📝 OBSIDIAN Properties Documentation 🔗 https://obsidian.md/help/properties ☕ Buy me a Coffee https://ko-fi.com/motion2082 #Obsidian #ObsidianBases #YAMLproperties #NoteTaking #PKM #ObsidianWebClipper
